info.name: EAC embed
info.summary: Let the collective's own sites show Nextcloud pages in a frame
info.description: Adds the origins in the app value `frame_ancestors` (comma-separated; default https://elkdonis-arts.org) to Nextcloud's frame-ancestors Content-Security-Policy, so a Talk call or a shared document can open inside a page of those sites. Source: the EAC monorepo, docker/nextcloud-apps/eac_embed.
info.author: Elkdonis Arts Collective
